newsitem.title: USA: Mobil restart underway at Calif. refinery.
newsitem.headline: Mobil restart underway at Calif. refinery.

text.p: Mobil Corp on Monday said it began to restart its 130,000 barrel-per-day (BPD) refinery south of Los Angeles, California late last week following a month-long maintenance shutdown.
"Some of our units have returned to service, others are on their way back up," said a refinery spokeswoman.
She declined to say which units returned to service, or the amount of refining capacity restored.
The restart began Friday after the crude distillation and several other unspecified units came out of planned maintenance work that began in late January.

The Mobil plant, located in Torrance, Calif., processes heavy crude oils, and prices for those grades rose 50 cents a barrel late Friday, on perceptions the refinery would begin to run more, traders said.
